parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Filter to a single Horizon queue name.

parameters.name: supervisor
parameters.description: Filter to all queues belonging to a supervisor.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: Filter to jobs tagged with the given tenant id.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Filter to a single fully-qualified job class.

parameters.name: age_min_seconds
parameters.description: Only include jobs older than this many seconds.

parameters.name: age_max_seconds
parameters.description: Only include jobs younger than this many seconds.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring search inside the raw Redis payload blob (use for payload-search 'find the job that touched order #1234').

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Spatie-style sort key. Prefix with `-` for descending. Allowed keys: `class`, `queue`, `supervisor`, `tenant_id`, `age_seconds`, `attempts`. Default is newest-first (by `pushed_at` desc) when omitted.
